Description: The sample or material being subjected to analysis.
A small volume of blood removed for testing or storage.
A biological sample containing components collected from bone marrow of an experimental subject.
A biospecimen comprised of purified or partially-purified cells.
A biospecimen that consists of a body fluid.
A sample consisting of biological material from the buccal cavity, collected by introducing a solution into the mouth, swishing, and collecting the rinse.
A respiratory biospecimen obtained via expectoration.
Portion of semisolid bodily waste discharged through the anus.
A piece of tissue removed from an organism for examination, analysis, or propagation.
